name: Alexander Wilson
bio: a Representative from Virginia; born in Virginia, birth date unknown; completed preparatory studies; member of the Virginia state house of delegates, 1803 and 1804; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Eighth Congress to fill the vacancy caused by the resignation of United States Representative Andrew Moore, and reelected to the two succeeding Congresses (November 13, 1804-March 3, 1809); death date unknown.
